subject: Hospitality
title: The Metaverse and Virtual Venues
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Metaverse and Virtual Venues.

hook.text: Fortnite hosted a virtual Travis Scott concert for 12 million simultaneous attendees.

buildup.text: Virtual event platforms like Virbela and Gather create 3D environments where avatars walk, talk.

discovery.text: Virtual venues eliminate travel costs, carbon emissions, and venue capacity limits.

twist.text: Engagement drops sharply in virtual events after 45 minutes. Human attention doesn't transfer well to screens.

climax.text: The metaverse won't replace physical events but will create a new category: global gatherings impossible in the physical world.

punchline.text: 12 million at one concert, zero carbon. Virtual venues are impossible, brilliant rooms.

quiz.question: How many people attended the virtual Travis Scott concert on Fortnite?
